top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Colombia Quake Tests New President Days Into Term
top_signals.summary: Rescuers in western Colombia are still searching for survivors after a 7.4 magnitude earthquake killed at least 287 people. Bloomberg News Latin America Government Reporter Mie Dahl joins Bloomberg This Weekend from Bogotá and explains to hosts Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar that the disaster has also disrupted coffee exports and created an immediate leadership test for President Abelardo de la Espriella, who was sworn in just days before the quake struck. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Ireland plans industry standards for illicit crypto use
top_signals.summary: The proposed policies under Ireland’s AML framework included stricter measures on transfers from private crypto wallets and overseas digital asset companies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: OCC grants conditional approval for Trump-backed World Liberty National Trust bank
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump-backed World Liberty Financial secured preliminary approval to become a national trust bank on Friday.
